title: Kill the Vampire
description: Sybille Stentor, court wizard of Solitude in the Blue Palace, asks you to wipe out a vampire nest by killing the Master Vampire in Pinemoon Cave. Return to her for jewelry and a free Illusion training session.

base_facts: I am the court wizard of Solitude and reside in the Blue Palace.
A nest of vampires in Pinemoon Cave threatens the hold and must be wiped out.
I will reward anyone who kills the Master Vampire there with jewelry and a free Illusion training session.

BEAT_ACCEPT_QUEST: The player agreed to kill the Master Vampire in Pinemoon Cave for me.
BEAT_VAMPIRE_KILLED: The Master Vampire in Pinemoon Cave has been slain.
BEAT_REPORT_COMPLETE: The player killed the vampire and I rewarded them. I am grateful.
Player returns to Sybille Stentor and reports the vampire is dead, receiving jewelry and Illusion training.
Return to Sybille Stentor for your reward.
Reward [ edit ] Exit the way you came in and return to Sybille Stentor for your reward, which is jewelry and a single free skill boost in Illusion.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Sybille Stentor and accepts the request to kill the Master Vampire in Pinemoon Cave.
Observes that the Master Vampire in Pinemoon Cave has been killed; the game sets stage 15 internally.
Player returns to Sybille Stentor and reports the vampire is dead, receiving jewelry and Illusion training.
